hooks.name: amh-session-start
hooks.description: AMH session bootstrap: installs the git pre-push rail, resets the command guard's advisory state and injects the session banner. Configured, never observed firing; written against the Gemini CLI v0.70.0 documentation, retrieved 2026-11-23. An untrusted folder ignores this whole file.

hooks.name: amh-command-guard
hooks.description: AMH command guard on run_shell_command calls: exit 2 refuses the call. Configured, never observed firing; written against the Gemini CLI v0.70.0 documentation, retrieved 2026-11-23, which says a hook failing any other way lets the call run (fail-open) and does not say whether hooks fire for a subagent's calls or in yolo or headless mode.

hooks.name: amh-redact-tool-output
hooks.description: AMH output redactor: replaces a tool result only when it redacted a credential shape scripts/redact.sh knows; it needs python3 and fails open. Configured, never observed firing; written against the Gemini CLI v0.70.0 documentation, retrieved 2026-11-23.
